skill.summary: Locate parking garages, lots, and street parking near your destination using Camino AI's location intelligence with AI-powered ranking.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of parking-finder skill.  
- Find parking garages, lots, and street parking near your destination using Camino AI’s location intelligence and AI-powered ranking.
- Supports queries by address, location, or coordinates; flexible radius and result limits.
- Returns AI-ranked parking options including distance and relevance scores.
- Includes setup and usage instructions for shell scripts and API (curl), with example queries.
- Part of the Camino AI suite for integrated location intelligence tasks.
